newsitem.title: USA: General Cable Corp registers offering.
newsitem.headline: General Cable Corp registers offering.

text.p: General Cable Corp said on Wednesday that it had filed with regulators to register an offering of its common stock under the company's stock incentive plan.
The stock plan is a compensation plan that provides awards of up to 2.45 million shares of common stock to key employees of the company based on performance standards.
On completion of its initial public offering, General Cable's directors made initial grants under the stock plan of stock options for about 1.1 million shares of common stock.
General Cable makes products for the wire and cable industry.
